given: stock records exist for one or more SKUs at one or more locations
when: the warehouse team member opens the home screen
then: a table lists one row per stock record showing that record's SKU, location, and quantity
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the React SPA (client/) rendering a list read through the boundary (app/routes/, renders_via react, JSON only) -> service (app/services/) -> repository (app/repositories/) -> models (app/models/) read of stock_records. No new persistence; reads the same table S1 writes, so PI1/PI2 guarantee one well-formed row per (sku, location). Cross-cutting: read-path shaping (row ordering/DTO) lives in the service, never the boundary or the React component; the query is the repository's sole ORM touch. Verified real-branch (NFR-F1-4): seed rows on the paired branch, assert the table renders one row per record with SKU/location/quantity.
